body.name: Version-invariant observed rank functional
body.construction: For disjoint measured \(A,B\subseteq V_0\), form \(\mathfrak F_{A,B}(P_X):=\{g\in C^1(\mathcal U_A;\mathbb R^{|B|}):\mathcal U_A\supseteq\operatorname{supp}(P_{X_A})\text{ is open and }g(X_A)=\mathbb E_{P_X}[X_B\mid X_A]\ P_X\text{-almost surely}\}\). Put \((A,B)\in\mathcal Q_{\mathrm{stab}}(P_X)\) exactly when the set \(\{\operatorname*{ess\,sup}_{x\sim P_{X_A}}\operatorname{rank}Dg(x):g\in\mathfrak F_{A,B}(P_X)\}\) is a singleton, and define \(R^{\mathrm{law}}_{P_X}(A,B)\) as that unique integer. Empty arguments have value zero. Both the domain and value depend only on the observed law.
